sources.title: Xylem, transpiration and source/sink phloem transport

assumptions: Mature green leaf making organic material, growing root as sink, suitable water-potential conditions and net inward CO2 diffusion. Four qualitative routes; chloroplast, stomatal and vascular drawing is schematic. Vapour is a separate branch. No real rates or time. Oxygen/minerals/other sinks omitted. Sugars are matter storing chemical energy; chemical energy is not a separate transported molecule.
